claim: code_map.md's build.jl entry names the trial binding as the walk's follower but omits `_check_event_declarations`, the draft-level pass that raises `EventHalfMissing` (reasons :guard, :handler, :not_an_event) and runs between the trial binding and the first barrier.
why: src/build.jl:784 runs _check_event_declarations between the trial binding (:783) and the first barrier (:787). :825-849 raise EventHalfMissing with :not_an_event, :guard and :handler. code_map.md:107-108 is still true: the trial binding runs after the walk, ahead of the first barrier. code_map.md:8-12 makes an entry a selective list of constructs. G1b (CV1-005/008/027/090/124) and G2b (CV8-104) ruled that the map owes no private helper. The raise itself is covered by Appendix C's EventHalfMissing entry (spec.md:15551-15554), whose three reasons match. The omission is no mismatch.

claim: The row types ComponentEntry, Anchor, RateScope, LevelEntry, Child and the accessor `membership` are reachable as `build.structure` rows and have docstrings, but spec §9.1/§9.2, Appendix B and docs/src/api.md name none of them or their fields.
why: src/structure.jl:139-198 defines the row types and `membership`. Probe P7: Structure's fields are Vector{ComponentEntry}, Vector{Anchor}, Vector{RateScope NamedTuple}, Vector{Symbol}, Vector{Type} and Vector{LevelEntry}. The module exports nothing (src/Redstone.jl has no export, per D-226), and docstring_rules.md rule 1 takes docs/src/api.md as the public set. api.md lists `Structure` but none of its row types, so they are internal. Spec §9.1 (design/spec.md:4958-4976) states the facts the rows hold: the components by path with their tier and rate chain, and one row per assembly with its children (each with its contributing field) and its wires. It does so without naming the types. | The statement is accurate as a fact: spec, Appendix B and api.md name no row type. But nothing in the docs contradicts the code, and the row type names are internal. D-261 in the log names ComponentEntry and Anchor. Whether Structure's fields and row types become public is owed to the exported-name audit (design/pending.md:89-96, 'It also settles which fields are public'). If they are made public, this becomes a gap row for that bullet.
